description.value: A municipal campground on the shores of Kootenay Lake in the charming village of Kaslo, with hot showers, free Wi-Fi, and a short walk to the S.S. Moyie National Historic Site and downtown; open spring through fall only with no published tent rate.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence from the Village of Kaslo campground webpage confirms hot showers, free Wi-Fi, and serviced and unserviced tent sites at a lakeside location steps from Kaslo's downtown core. OSM tags corroborate tent camping (tents=yes), power supply, free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no), and 40-site capacity. A street-name discrepancy exists between the OSM address (2nd Street) and the website description (foot of A Avenue), and the phone number 250-353-2662 appears only on the website with no corresponding OSM field.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '2nd Street' but the campground website locates the facility 'at the foot of A Avenue' — the correct street address should be verified on the ground.
Phone number (250-353-2662) and email (kaslocampground@yahoo.ca) appear only on the website; neither is populated in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-documented, municipally operated campground on Kootenay Lake with tent sites, hot showers, and free Wi-Fi — a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists on the Kootenay lake route.

wow_evidence: municipal campground on the shores of Kootenay Lake… hot showers, free Wi-Fi
